ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, with (preposition) · 'where' as a place conjunction (ኀበ ትነብር 'where she dwells'; ch. 17–19 headings)
ለወልዱ: ወልድ — to his son (ለ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone)
ባሕቲቱ: ባሕቲት — his solitude, himself alone (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately')
ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay')
ምንተ: ምንት — what? (interrogative pronoun, accusative) · exclamatory 'how' (ምንተ ሠነየኒ ቃልከ 'how pleasing to me is your word')
መንግሥተ: መንግሥት — kingdom (construct 'kingdom of') · also the plain accusative 'a kingdom' (ዘይነፍቅ መንግሥተ 'who would seize a kingdom')
እንበር: ነበረ — that I stay, dwell (1cs subjunctive, G, n-b-r)
እሖር: ሖረ — that I go (1cs subjunctive, G, ḥ-w-r)
ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun; construct 'son of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደ ታራ ወልደ 'Terah begot a son'; ch. 13)
ዘይኄይስ: ኀየሰ — which is better (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G, 'be good, better')
ብእሲተ: ብእሲት — wife (noun; construct 'wife of') · accusative 'a woman, a wife' (አውሰበ አሐተ ብእሲተ 'he married one woman')
አውሥኦ: አውሥአ — he answered him (3ms perfect + -ኦ 'him'; the person answered is the object)
አነሂ: አነ — I also, I too (1s independent pronoun + enclitic -ሂ 'also')
ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct)
ሎቱ: ለ — to him, for him (preposition ለ- with 3m sg suffix -tu: ሎቱ)
እምነ: እምነ — from (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · from among (እምነ ኴሉ ነጋድያን 'from among all the merchants'; 'apart from' is also possible there) · than, in comparison (ጥበብ ትኄይስ እምነ ኴሉ 'wisdom is better than all')
እመሕያው: እመሕያው — mankind, human being (noun; compound of እም 'mother' + ሕያው 'living'; genitive after እጓለ)
ገብረ: ገብር — servant, slave (noun; accusative predicate in -a, after ኩን) · also the verb ገብረ: he did, made (3ms perfect, g-b-r; ገብረ ሠናየ 'he did good')
በከመ: ከመ — according as, just as (በ- + ከመ, conjunction)
ፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — he wished, wanted, desired (3ms perfect, G)
ወአንተሰ: አንተ — and as for you (ወ- + 2ms pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ
በደኃሪ: ደኃሪ — in the end, afterward (በ- 'in' + adjective used as noun) · in the last (በደኃሪ ባሕር 'in the last sea'; the adjective ደኃሪ 'last' agrees with the noun)
ወከመ: ከመ — and that (ወ- 'and' + conjunction) · and like, and as (ወ- + ከመ 'like, as' before a noun: ወከመ ፈውስ ለድዉይ 'and like healing to the sick')
ወውእቱሰ: ውእቱ — and he, as for him (ወ- + pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
ዓም: ዓመት — year (noun, contracted ዓም; after a numeral) (?)
ወአንሥኦ: አንሥአ — and he raised him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative, n-ś-ʾ + -ኦ 'him'; subject not stated)
ለዘ: ዘ — (to/of the one) whom (ለ- + relative pronoun; ወቦ ለዘ 'and there is one whom') · to him who (ለእግዚኣብሔር ለዘ ገብረ ኵሎ 'to God, who made all')
ወአንሰ: አነ — and as for me (ወ- 'and' + 1s pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
ዓመት: ዓመት — year (noun, fem.; after a numeral)
እምዘ: ዘ — from him who (እም- + relative pronoun) · 'beyond what' (እምዘ ኢተሐዘብኩ 'beyond what I had expected')
እምከ: እም — your mother (noun + -ከ '2ms your'; here after እምነ 'than')
ወለእመ: እመ — and if (ወ- + ለእመ, conditional conjunction)
መዋዕለ: መዋዕል — days (noun, plural of ዕለት; construct 'days of')
ወትነብር: ነበረ — and she sits, dwells (ወ- + 3fs imperfect) · also 2ms 'and you will dwell' (ወትነብር ውስተ ብሔርነ)
መጠነ: መጠን — measure; መጠነ 'as far as, according to the measure of' (construct as conjunction/preposition)
ፈቀድከ: ፈቀደ — you wished, desired (2ms perfect, G)
ምድረ: ምድር — land, earth (noun, f.; construct 'land of' / accusative)
ለአበዊነ: አብ — to our fathers (ለ- + plural አበው, አበዊ- + -ነ '1cp our')
ገብሩ: ገብር — servant of (noun, construct form, followed by genitive ለ-) · his servant (ገብር + -ሁ '3ms his', ለዳዊት ገብሩ 'to David his servant')
እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as, up to (preposition) · conjunction 'until' before a subjunctive (እስከ ይትፌጸም 'until might be fulfilled')
ወትከውን: ኮነ — and you will be (ወ- + 2ms imperfect, k-w-n; the same letters could be 3fs 'she', see the unit note)
ዘአልቦ: አልቦ — which has not, there is not (ዘ- + አልቦ 'not-with-him', negative existential)
ኆልቈ: ኆልቍ — number, count (noun, accusative ኆልቈ; ዘአልቦ ኆልቈ 'without number')
ወታቦተ: ታቦት — and the Ark (ወ- + noun, fem.; construct 'ark of')
አምላከ: አምላክ — God of (noun, construct) · also accusative 'a god' (ካልአ አምላከ 'another god')
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he (3m sg independent pronoun) · also demonstrative 'that' before a noun (በውስተ ውእቱ ሥዕለ 'in that image') and copula 'it is' after a predicate (ጽድቅ ውእቱ 'true it is')
ለዝሉፉ: ዝሉፍ — unidentified, perhaps 'for good, continually' (?) (ለ- + word perhaps related to ዘልፈ; uncertain)
ወትገብር: ገብረ — and you shall make (ወ- + 2ms imperfect)
ለትውልደ: ትውልድ — for generation of (ለ- + noun, construct; ለትውልደ ትውልድ 'from generation to generation')
ወአውሥአ: አውሥአ — and he answered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ወሥአ)
ኀቤሃ: ኀበ — to her, toward her (preposition ኀበ + -ሃ '3fs')
ፍጡነ: ፍጡን — quick, quickly (adjective, accusative as adverb)
በኀበ: ኀበ — before, with, in the presence of (በ- + ኀበ) · among (በኀበ ማእምራን 'among the knowing') · 'where' (conj.) (በኀበ ሀለውኩ 'where I am')
ሀለውኩ: ሀሎ — I was, I was there (1sg perfect, h-l-w) · used as a present, 'I am' (በኀበ ሀለውኩ 'where I am')
እርአይ: ርእየ — I see (1cs subjunctive, G; ዘእንበለ እርአይ 'without my seeing')
ገጸከ: ገጽ — your face (noun + -ከ '2ms your', stem ገጸ- before the suffix)
ወእስማዕ: ሰምዐ — and that I hear (ወ- + 1cs jussive, G)
በዳኅን: ዳኅን — in safety, in health (በ- + noun)
